overview_description.description: Arabian Shield operates as an insurance company that offers personal and business insurance services for both companies and individuals. They offer various individual insurance services, such as craftsman insurance, travel insurance, and medical insurance. They also provide corporate insurance services such as property insurance, public liability insurance, and personal accident insurance.
